sara_sales: Heads-up team: new pilot with a regulated fintech. They want streaming responses + function calls that return strict JSON lines for our ingestion pipeline. Also SSO, customer-managed KMS, and an enterprise security questionnaire. Need quick checklist + pilot pricing.

leo_eng: Quick clarifying q's: 1) streaming protocol: SSE or websocket? 2) do function results need to be guaranteed in-order for the conversation? 3) callback webhooks or inline function outputs?

sara_sales: They prefer SSE (server-sent events). Ordered per-conversation (audit) is required. Inline function outputs are preferred but async callbacks ok for heavy batches.

leo_eng: Ok. Implementation pattern we recommend: 1) use SSE endpoint with per-session affinity (session pinning) to preserve ordering; 2) emit function_call events with "arguments" as compact JSON; 3) validate against a JSON Schema client-side. Example Go client snippet for parsing streaming func calls:
```go
stream := client.StreamGenerate(ctx, params)
for evt := range stream.Ch {
  switch evt.Type {
  case "function_call":
    var args map[string]interface{}
    json.Unmarshal([]byte(evt.Payload), &args)
    // validate args against schema before ingestion
  case "response_chunk":
    // append to buffer
  }
}
```

mike_sec: Security notes: we support SAML/OIDC for SSO + SCIM for provisioning. For data encryption at rest with customer keys, we support AWS KMS and GCP KMS for Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted, we can enable CMK for enterprise customers behind a contract. Also require IP allowlist and TLS mutual auth for webhook endpoints for higher assurance.

anya_ops: Ops notes: for ordered delivery use Dedicated with session pinning to avoid cross-worker reorder. Enable KV cache TTLs carefully if they reuse prefixes. For telemetry, enable token-level cost breakdown and export traces to their SIEM. We'll queue a Dedicated pool sizing run if they commit.

sara_sales: Pricing ballpark for procurement: pilot 1 month, 150k tokens/day streaming + func calls. Any quick numbers?

leo_eng: Ballpark hosted: streaming gen ~ $0.0007 per token (varies by model). 150k/day * 30 = 4.5M tokens -> ~$3.15k/mo. If SLA/ordering required pick Dedicated reserved capacity: expect starting commit ~$18k/month for small pool (depends on region/instance sizes). We can propose a hybrid: hosted for dev + dedicated for prod path.

mike_sec: Timeline for security review: SAML + KMS integration + questionnaire typically 2-3 weeks if no on-prem HSM. Add 1-2 weeks for SCIM + IP allowlist coordination.

sara_sales: Can we get a one-page integration checklist I can send to the buyer and a small sample JSON schema for their function outputs?

leo_eng: Dropping a compact checklist here: 1) Confirm model choice and token budget 2) Choose hosting mode (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) 3) SSO type + SCIM 4) KMS (AWS/GCP/Redwood-managed) 5) Webhook details & mTLS if used 6) JSON Schema for function output 7) Telemetry destination + retention 8) Pilot dates + success criteria

leo_eng: Sample JSON schema (very small):
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "transaction_id": {"type":"string"},
    "amount": {"type":"number"},
    "currency": {"type":"string"},
    "merchant": {"type":"string"}
  },
  "required": ["transaction_id","amount","currency"]
}
```

deploy-bot: [task] Dedicated pool sizing job created: job-id ds-4412. No action required unless config overrides provided.

anya_ops: I'll prep the SIEM export doc and sample retention policy. Also ping infra to prepare a quantized fallback model if cost becomes blocker.

leo_eng: I'll run a quick model-mix sim (full vs quantized) and post numbers EOD. Will include failure/fallback policy (e.g., degrade to quantized-4 model at 95th percentile load).

sara_sales: Amazing, thanks. I'll attach this checklist to the security questionnaire and reply to the buyer. If we get an NDA signed, can someone prep an architecture diagram for Private deployment? :handshake:
